name: Basecamp
description: Basecamp's hosted server reads projects, to-dos, message boards and schedules and can add to them as your account.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (app.basecamp.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
